get.description: Returns trade details where the requestor is the Platform, either party associated with the trade, or the account group where the trade was settled. For the party information, the asset is the settlement currency (i.e asset RECEIVED). This means in the second you are receiving USD correctly, 00SCXM is receiving BTC. The "sell" side receives the quoted currency, the "buy" side receives the underlying. Our trade structure mirrors a typical back office trade report (FIX TradeCaptureReport) and we use the concept of settlement currency for the sides to help keep our system agnostic of symbol definitions. Results are limited to the last 2 months

parameters.name: market_identifier_code
parameters.description: Filters for trades within a designated `market_identifier_code`.

parameters.name: omit_market_identifier_code
parameters.description: Filters for trades excluding those from a particular `market_identifier_code`.

parameters.name: platform_code
parameters.description: Filters for trades based on the specific `platform_code` where the trade execution took place.

parameters.name: omit_platform_code
parameters.description: Filters for trades based excluding those from a particular `platform_code`.

parameters.name: trade_state
parameters.description: Filters for trades based on their current `trade_state`.

parameters.name: settlement_state
parameters.description: Filters for trades based on their current `settlement_state`.

parameters.name: party_code
parameters.description: Filters for trades where the provided `party_code` is at least one of the counterparties to a trade in the `parties` array.

parameters.name: transaction_timestamp[gt]
parameters.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp greater than the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

parameters.name: transaction_timestamp[gte]
parameters.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp greater than or equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

parameters.name: transaction_timestamp[e]
parameters.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

parameters.name: transaction_timestamp[lt]
parameters.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp less than the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

parameters.name: transaction_timestamp[lte]
parameters.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp less than or equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

parameters.name: client_trade_id
parameters.description:
Filters for trades with the provided `client_trade_id` value.
Note:
 - Platforms integrated to the zerohash RFQ systems, the `quote_id` from the RFQ will be saved as the `client_trade_id` once the quote has been executed.
- Platforms integrated to the zerohash CLOB, the `execution_id` from the order trade execution will be saved as the `client_trade_id` on the resulting trade.

parameters.name: execution_id
parameters.description: Filters for trades with the provided `execution_id` in either party's `execution_id` field.

parameters.name: reporting_party
parameters.description: Filters for trades based on the `reporting_party` associated with each trade.

parameters.name: settlement_schedule
parameters.description: Filters for trades based on the `settlement_schedule` associated with each trade.

200.description: Successfully retrieved paginated list of trades with optional filters: participant_code, asset, underlying, account_label, market_identifier_code, platform_code, trade_state, settlement_state, party_code, transaction_timestamp, client_trade_id, execution_id, reporting_party, settlement_schedule.

post.description: Creates a new customer account. The pair (`participant_code`, `account_label`) is unique per participant and is used as idempotency check rather than `X-Request-Id`; submitting the same pair a second time returns an error rather than creating a duplicate.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the customer account details to create.

202.description:
Creating a customer account is an asynchronous process that does several operations in the background after the response is returned. 
 Customers are advised to listen to the `customer_account_status_changed` webhook event to be notified when the account is active and ready to use.

patch.description: Updates prefunded and tier values for an existing customer account.

parameters.name: zrn
parameters.description: The ZRN of the customer account to add advisor to. The ZRN must be in the format: `zrn:zh:eu:account:customer:<uuid>`

requestBody.description: New prefunded and tier values for the account

202.description:
Customer account updated successfully. Updating an existing customer account is an asynchronous process that does several operations in the background after the response is returned. 
 Customers are advised to listen to the `customer_account_status_changed` webhook event to be notified when the account is active and ready to use.

get.description: Returns a locked network fee quote for a planned crypto withdrawal. The returned `withdrawal_quote_id` is valid for 30 seconds and must be passed to POST /withdrawals/execute to complete the withdrawal. Exactly one of `withdrawal_account_id` or `withdrawal_address` must be supplied; if `max_amount` is `false` (the default), `amount` is required.

parameters.name: participant_code
parameters.description: The participant the withdrawal will be debited from. 6-character alphanumeric code.

parameters.name: account_group
parameters.description: The `account_group` for the source account. Defaults to the caller's `participant_code` when omitted.

parameters.name: account_label
parameters.description: The `account_label` for the source account. Defaults to `general` when omitted.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: The asset code of the asset being withdrawn, e.g. BTC.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The requested withdrawal amount. Required (and must be positive) unless `max_amount` is `true`.

parameters.name: max_amount
parameters.description: When `true`, zerohash will generate a withdrawal for the full available balance of `asset` in the source account; in that case `amount` can be omitted. Defaults to `false`. Accepted as the string `"true"` or `"false"`.

parameters.name: withdrawal_account_id
parameters.description: The `withdrawal_account_id` of the whitelisted destination account. Required when `withdrawal_address` is not provided.

parameters.name: withdrawal_address
parameters.description: The on-chain address that will receive the crypto asset. Required when `withdrawal_account_id` is not provided.

parameters.name: destination_tag
parameters.description: The destination tag or memo ID associated with the transaction. Required when the asset is EOS, XLM, or XRP and `no_destination_tag` is `false`.

parameters.name: no_destination_tag
parameters.description: Whether the destination address requires a destination tag. Required for tag-based assets (EOS, XLM, XRP). zerohash requires `no_destination_tag` to be `false` for EOS. Accepted as the string `"true"` or `"false"`.

200.description: Successfully retrieved locked network fee quote. including `withdrawal_quote_id`, `net_withdrawal_quantity`, and the locked network/withdrawal fees.

patch.description:
Update one or more fields of an existing Entity user (Control Person, Beneficial Owner, or Board Member). This is a partial update endpoint - only the fields provided in the request body will be updated.

**Important notes:**

**Platform configuration:**
- Your platform must be properly configured before using this endpoint.

**PII changes and document requirements:**
- When users are updated with new identifying information (such as `first_name`, `last_name`, `date_of_birth`, or `citizenship_code`), these changes must be accompanied by supporting documentation.
- Use the Submit Documents endpoint with the appropriate document type to provide supporting documents.

**Compliance field updates:**
- Updating KYC-related fields (`sanction_screening`, `kyc`, `id_number_type`, etc.) may require re-verification depending on your platform configuration.
- Changes to identity documents or verification status may trigger additional compliance checks.

**Vendor reliance track:**
- For platforms using vendor reliance track, `sanction_screening` and `kyc` fields must be provided with vendor verification results.
- `sanction_screening_timestamp` and `kyc_timestamp` should be set to the time when the vendor completed the verification (in milliseconds since Unix epoch).

**Conditional requirements:**
- If `id_number_type` is `non_us_other`, the `non_us_other_type` field is required to describe the ID type.
- For non-US citizens or when `tax_id` is an ITIN (begins with 9), `id_number_type` and `id_number` are required.

**Response:**
Returns the complete user object with all fields, including unchanged fields and system-generated metadata.

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: Unique identifier related to the user

requestBody.description: Updated entity user fields (all fields optional, only send fields to update)

200.description: Successfully updated entity user. Returns the updated resource.

Submits a business document on behalf of an entity, or an identity document on behalf of a control person or a beneficial owner of the entity, if you operate a platform on zerohash.

**EU NNP onboarding.** For an entity onboarded through an EU-region platform, the required document set is `lei_certificate`, `excerpt_of_the_chamber_of_commerce`, `annual_accounts`, and `power_of_authorization` (a power of attorney or a board resolution authorising the submitter). When the entity was created with `is_complex_structure: true`, a `legal_opinion` document is additionally required before the entity can be approved. Any document without a dedicated type can be uploaded as `supporting_document` with a free-text `document_description`.

get.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of a payout. Identify the payout by **exactly one** of `payout_id` or `idempotency_key` — supplying neither or both returns `400 Bad Request`. The response is lifecycle-only (PII-free); full per-resource details are fetched from the existing per-resource endpoints (`GET /participants/{code}`, `GET /payments/external_accounts/{id}`, `GET /payments/{payment_id}`) once the caller has the identifier. All queries are scoped to the caller's `platform_code`; a `payout_id` belonging to another tenant returns `404 Not Found` (indistinguishable from a non-existent payout).

post.description:
Single endpoint that drives the full payout lifecycle. The optional `validate` body field switches between two modes:

- `validate: true` — runs the full pre-flight pipeline (schema, business-logic, and address-validity checks) with **no side effects**. Returns `200 OK` with body `{}` on success, `400 Bad Request` with `errors[]` on any validation failure, or `422 Unprocessable Entity` with `errors[]` if the payout asset is currently depegged. Nothing is persisted; no beneficiary, external account, or payment is created. The `Idempotency-Key` header is not required and is ignored if supplied.

- `validate: false` or omitted (submit) — runs the same validation pipeline then executes the payout. **Requires the `Idempotency-Key` header.** On success returns `202 Accepted` with a slim `{ idempotency_key, payout_id, status }` body; full resource state is retrieved via `GET /payouts` or observed on `payout.status_updated` webhooks. The (`platform_code`, `Idempotency-Key`) pair is unique: replaying the same key with the canonical-JSON-equivalent body returns the original `202` echo-back; replaying with a different body returns `400`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key (stable across retries of the same logical operation). **Required when `validate` is omitted or `false`.** Ignored in validate mode. zerohash stores a SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized JSON body alongside this key; a replay with the same key but a different body returns HTTP 400.

requestBody.description: Payout payload. See `PostPayoutsRequest` for field-level rules.

200.description: Validate-mode success (only returned when `validate: true`). All three validation tiers passed. Body is intentionally empty.

202.description: Submit-mode success. The payout has been accepted and is now pending. Asynchronous processing continues; observe state changes via `payout.status_updated` webhooks or `GET /payouts`. Returned only when `validate` is omitted or `false`.

400.description: Validation failure. A schema, business-logic, or address-validity check failed, OR an `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different request body. Body uses the standard `errors[]` envelope. Nothing is persisted.

payorNotApproved.summary: Business logic — top-level payor not approved

addressDenyList.summary: Address validity — deny list or network mismatch

errors: beneficiary.external_account.info.crypto_address is not a valid SOL address

idempotencyMismatch.summary: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

errors: Idempotency-Key was previously used with a different request body

missingIdempotencyKey.summary: Submit mode without an Idempotency-Key header

422.description: Operational halt — the supplied `payment.asset` is currently depegged and new conversions are halted. Returns 422 (not 400) because the request itself is well-formed; the current state simply prevents execution. Nothing is persisted; the `Idempotency-Key` is NOT consumed and may be reused once the depeg clears. Replays of a pre-depeg payout with the same key + body still echo back 202 normally.

errors: asset is currently depegged and conversions are halted

post.description:
Retrieves a quote for a pay event for a given participant code and asset.
The response includes a deposit address and rate at which a subsequent on-chain deposit will be honored.

The quote has an expiry timestamp (`price_expire_ts`) — for volatile assets, the platform must execute the deposit before this time,
or a new quote can be requested for the same payment to refresh the price.
For stablecoins, `price_expire_ts` will be `null`.

The `request_id` you send (via the `X-Request-Id` header) is the idempotency key for this endpoint: re-submitting the same `request_id` returns the existing active quote — same `transaction_id`, deposit address, and rate — instead of creating a new one.

Use the returned `transaction_id` as the path parameter when calling `POST /pay/{id}/rfq` to refresh a quote.

After the on-chain deposit settles or fails, a `crypto_pay_status_changed` webhook reports the outcome (`success` + `status_reason_code`).

200.description: Pay quote created successfully

401.description: The platform, jurisdiction, or asset is not enabled for the Pay product. The `{"error": ...}` body is one of "Your Platform is not configured to use the Pay product", "The State you live in is not authorized to use this product", or "Asset not enabled for pay".

403.description: The transaction is not authorized. Possible causes: manual approval is required before this transaction can proceed (Level 4 shoppers — the body contains a transaction_id identifying the approval review), or the shopper has exceeded their daily spend limit at the current authorization level. A generic `{"error":"Transaction not authorized"}` body is returned when the transaction is hard-denied (no remediation).

409.description: Shopper KYC requirements are not met for this transaction.

422.description: The transaction could not be authorized. The `{"error": ...}` body is either "Participant is not authorized to transact" (the participant/merchant relationship or state precludes authorization) or "Transaction not authorized" (the authorizer returned an unrecognized status).

post.description:
Refreshes an existing pay quote identified by its transaction ID.
This is used when a previously issued quote is near to expire and the platform wants a new rate for the same deposit address.
Already expired quotes can't be refreshed.

The response format is identical to `POST /pay/rfq` — it returns an updated rate, expiry timestamp, and the same deposit address.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The transaction ID (UUID) returned from the original POST /pay/rfq call

200.description: Pay quote refreshed successfully

Code400.description: Request was rejected by validation or a downstream service. `errors` is an array of human-readable messages; each entry describes a single validation failure or business-rule violation.

Code403.description: Authentication or authorization failed. `error` is always `true`; `message` explains which check failed (missing API key, bad signature, insufficient permission, etc.).

message.example: This api key does not have write permission to this endpoint

Code404.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Code500.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server. The request can be retried after a short delay, but the same inputs may reproduce the error.

Code503.description: A downstream dependency was unavailable, timed out, or returned a retryable error. Safe to retry; the response carries a `zh-allow-retry: true` header.

error.example: Shopper KYC requirements for this transaction are not met
error.description: Human-readable error message indicating the shopper is missing required KYC data for the requested transaction.

missing_requirements.description: List of participant fields that must be collected or updated for the shopper to pass authorization at the requested amount and merchant MCC tier.

error.example: Shopper's Daily Spend Limit for this type of transaction have been hit.
error.description: Returned with a 403 status when the shopper has exceeded their daily or lifetime spend aggregate at the current authorization level. Lifting the limit requires manual review.

error.example: Manual approval required for this transaction
error.description: Human-readable error message. Possible values: "Manual approval required for this transaction" (no approval on file yet), "Approval pending, shopper must wait" (an approval request is already in review), "Manual approval for this transaction was rejected" (the approval was rejected by compliance or the platform), or "Manual approval for this transaction has already been finalized" (the approval was already consumed).

transaction_id.description: Identifier of the manual approval review. Persist this and re-use it when checking approval status or cancelling the request.

error.description: Returned when an upstream authorization dependency is unreachable. Clients should retry after the duration specified by the Retry-After header.

Generic authorization denial with no remediation. Returned with HTTP 403 — `{"error":"Transaction not authorized"}` when the authorizer rejection has no specific mapping or reports no missing fields, or `{"error":"Transaction not permitted"}` when the participant is not permitted to transact (e.g. geographic restriction) — and with HTTP 422 (`{"error":"Participant is not authorized to transact"}`) when the participant/merchant context precludes authorization.

AccountMovementsEntity.title: Movements Entity
AccountMovementsEntity.description: Entity schema for an itemized account movement.

order_id.description: Sequence order of the movement within its run. Only present when enabled for the requesting platform.

run_id.description: A unique ID for the run that produced this movement.

movement_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the movement was applied.

movement_id.description: A unique ID for the specific account movement.

trade_id.description: Unique identifier of the trade or loan that resulted in the movement, when the movement was due to a trade or loan. Equal to the `trade_id` field returned by the `/trades` endpoint. Returns null when the movement is not trade-related.

deposit_reference_id.description: External identifier associated with the deposit, when the movement was due to a deposit. Equal to the `reference_id` field returned by the `/deposits` endpoint. Returns null when the movement is not a deposit.

withdrawal_request_id.description: Withdrawal request ID, when the movement was due to a withdrawal. Equal to the `id` field returned by the `/withdrawals/requests` endpoint. Returns null when the movement is not a withdrawal.

change.description: Signed decimal change to the account balance due to this movement, expressed as a string to preserve precision.

parent_link_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent transaction that produced this movement (e.g. the trade ID for trade-settlement movements). Returns null when the movement has no linked parent transaction.

origin.description: Indicates how the movement was initiated: via the REST API, SDK, or Secondary Portal. Returns null for movements without a recorded origin (e.g. automated system-generated movements).

WithdrawLockCustomerAccountBody.title: Withdraw Lock Customer Account Request Body
WithdrawLockCustomerAccountBody.description: Request body for withdraw-locking a customer account. Withdraw-locking an account prevents any new withdrawal requests from being created on the account, but does not impact the ability to create trades or deposits. This is typically used as a precautionary measure when suspicious activity is detected on an account, in order to prevent potential funds outflows while an investigation is conducted.

WithdrawUnlockCustomerAccountBody.title: Withdraw Unlock Customer Account Request Body
WithdrawUnlockCustomerAccountBody.description: Request body for withdraw-unlocking a customer account. Withdraw-unlocking an account removes the restriction on creating new withdrawal requests on the account. This is typically used to lift a withdraw-lock that was previously placed on an account as a precautionary measure when suspicious activity was detected, after the investigation has concluded and any issues have been resolved.

DivestCustomerAccountBody.title: Divest Customer Account Request Body
DivestCustomerAccountBody.description: Request body for divesting a customer account. Divesting an account initiates the process of liquidating the account's assets and closing the account. This is typically used when an account is being closed or transferred to another entity.

source.description: The bank from which the fiat deposit was made or the blockchain address from which the crypto deposit came. Returns `null` when the upstream service does not report a source (e.g. some fiat deposits).

received_address.description: The deposit address that received the funds. Returns `null` for fiat deposits and for crypto deposits where no receive address is recorded.

run_id.description: Identifier for the settlement run that booked the deposit.

state_reason.description: Machine-readable reason the deposit is in its current state. Populated for blockchain deposits held for Travel Rule verification: `required_travel_rule_info` — awaiting TR resolution; `travel_rule_info_received` — resolved successfully; `travel_rule_info_timeout` — 48h timer expired. Absent for fiat deposits and blockchain deposits not subject to Travel Rule.

Always present for blockchain deposits. `pending` — deposit is held awaiting TR verification; `completed` — TR resolved (info received or 48h timer elapsed); `not_required` — deposit never entered a TR-hold state. Absent for fiat deposits.

side.description: The side of the transaction

quantity.description: The `quantity` of the `underlying` asset requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

total.description: The total amount of the `quoted_currency` requested in the quote. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied.

spread.description: Define the quote spread in basis points

commission.description: Define the quote commission in basis points. Only allowed when the commission feature is enabled for the platform. Mutually exclusive with spread.

name.description: The name of the payment processor

quote_id.description:
The identifier for the quote
Note: this is required to execute the quote

total.description: The total amount of the `quoted_currency` requested in the quote. Only allowed to update the `total` field, not `quantity`. Must be less than or equal to the original `total` amount in the quote.

quote_id.description:
The identifier for the quote
Note: this is required to execute the quote

withdrawal_request_id.description: Optional withdrawal request ID to associate with the execution. Used by flows that pre-create a withdrawal record and then execute a quote against it.

always_allocate.description: When true, force allocation of the trade even if the quote has expired or partially filled.

funding_details.description: ACH funding details, required only for ACH-funded executions. Supply either an `inbound_reference_id` (to settle against an already-received inbound) or the `external_account_id`/`description`/`bank_fee` trio (to initiate a new ACH pull).

oneOf.title: Funding Details Object - Inbound ACH Transfer
oneOf.description: Funding details for an inbound ACH transfer. `inbound_reference_id` is the unique identifier for the payment.

inbound_reference_id.description: Reference ID of an already-received inbound ACH payment to settle this trade against.

oneOf.title: Funding Details Object - External Account
oneOf.description: Funding details for an external account transfer.

external_account_id.description: Registered external bank account to pull funds from.

description.description: Short free-form description written to the ACH statement (max 10 characters).

bank_fee.description: Bank fee notional (decimal string) applied to this ACH pull.

ach_details.description: Echoed ACH execution details. Only present when the execution used `funding_details` (ACH).

participant_code.description: Unique participant code associated with the customer generated by zerohash. This is the identifier that will be used in all other endpoints to refer to this customer.

email.description:
Customer email address, required.
Note: zerohash will validate that the email is a correctly formatted `email`, and that the value is unique per-platform

participant_code.description: Unique participant code

tax_id.description: Participant has provided a Tax ID

edd.description: Participant has provided information for Enhanced Due Diligence

edd_required.description: Enhanced Due Diligence is required for the Participant and needs to be provided to move forward with onboarding

tags.description: Tags associated with KYC Tier of Participant

participant_status.description: The current status of the participant

kyc_attempts.description: The number of KYC attempts the participant has gone through

email_screening.description: Whether the participant passed email screening

type.description: The actions that are restricted by the limit

period.description: The period in hours on which the limit is applied. A period of 0 means a lifetime limit

balance.description: The current balance for the asset

limit.description: The limit represents the volume that is permitted over the period

configured_limit.description: The configured unencumbered limit value set for the asset

asset.description: The currency in which the limit is given

participant_code.description: Unique participant code

status.description: The current status of the participant

action_reason.description: If the participant has changed statuses, the reason code will give more details like `compliance_issue`, `user_request`, or `risk_cleared`

user_email.description: Identifier of the user who last acted on this participant. Typically an email address, but may be any opaque user identifier.

name.description: Full display name of the participant.

first_name.description: First name of the participant.

last_name.description: Last name of the participant.

email.description: Email of the participant.

address_one.description:
First line for the customer's address.

Notes:
- The regular maximum length is 80 characters.
- If the platform is on the vendor reliance track, the maximum length increases to 200 characters.
- PO Box addresses are not accepted.

address_two.description:
Extra information, like an apartment or suite number.

Notes:
- The regular maximum length is 50 characters.
- If the platform is on the vendor reliance track, the maximum length increases to 200 characters.
- PO Box addresses are not accepted.

postal_code.description: Postal, or zip code, of the business, in the format "min 4 characters, no leading or trailing spaces" for non-US postal code or <5digits>-<4digits> for US zip code, e.g. 77777 or 77777-7777

date_established.description: Date the business was established. This should reflect government registration for the entity in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

legal_name.description: Registered legal name of the entity. This should not be a DBA or DBA equivalent

entity_type.description: The type of business that is onboarding, must be one of the supported

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the participant

signed_timestamp.description: The time at which the business accepted zerohash services agreements

kyc_timestamp.description: The timestamp at which the KYC was completed

sanction_screening_timestamp.description: The time the sanctions screen was done

kyc_participant_track.description: KYC track the participant was onboarded under (e.g. `vendor reliance`).

jurisdiction_updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the jurisdiction was last updated.

kyc_tier.description: The KYC tier currently held by the participant (e.g. `FULL`, `LIGHT`).

jurisdiction_code.description: The ISO 3166-2 subdivision code that the customer resides in

id_number.description: The ID number for the customer

id_number_type.description: The type of ID number that is provided, must be one of the supported types.

non_us_other_type.description: A freeform string to describe the ID type that does not fit into the other predefined categories of ID types.

id_issuing_authority.description: ISO-3166-1_A2 country code that issued the ID

non_us_entity_tax_id.description: The tax identifier for a non-US entity

tax_id.description: The national ID of the participant, e.g. a social security number.

kyc.description: Whether the participant passed or failed KYC by vendor.

onboarding_profile.description: Onboarding profile used to determine the participant's KYC track. Defaults to 'kyc_track' when omitted.

merchant_category_code.description: ISO 18245 four-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC) that identifies the business activity of the entity. Accepted on entity create/update; zerohash derives `merchant_category_code_category` and `merchant_category_code_classification` from this value.

merchant_category_code_category.description: Human-readable category derived by zerohash from `merchant_category_code`. Returned in responses only; not accepted as input.

merchant_category_code_classification.description: Classification derived by zerohash from `merchant_category_code`, used to determine how the merchant is treated for downstream payment flows. Returned in responses only; not accepted as input.

sanction_screening.description: Whether the participant passed sanctions checks.

idv.description: Whether the participant passed or failed ID verification.

liveness_check.description: Whether the participant passed or failed a liveness check on their onboarding experience.

employment_status.description: The employment status of the participant.

industry.description: The industry in which the participant is employed.

source_of_funds.description: How the participant funds their account to support their trading activity.

type.description: The type of the agreement signed

region.description: The region for the signed agreement

signed_timestamp.description: The UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) when the Agreement was accepted by the participant. This timestamp value must be from no longer than one (1) year in the past or one (1) day in the future.

onboarded_location.description: The location of a participant during onboarding, ISO 3166-2 standard

savings_and_investments.description: Savings and investments of the participant.

tx_equivalent_annual_volume.description: The estimated total value of transactions the individual expects to process annually on the platform, in a specified currency (e.g., USD, EUR depends on region).

gross_annual_income_amount.description: The individual's total pre-tax income from all sources annually, in a currency (e.g., USD, EUR depends on region).

gross_annual_salary_amount.description: The individual's gross annual salary amount, in a currency (e.g., USD, EUR depends on region).

savings_and_investments_amount.description: The individual's total amount of savings and investments, in a currency (e.g., USD, EUR depends on region).

gross_annual_income.description: The individual's total gross annual income amount, in a currency (e.g., USD, EUR depends on region).

tx_usd_equivalent_monthly_amount.description: The estimated total value of transactions the individual expects to process monthly on the platform, in USD.

tx_usd_equivalent_annual_amount.description: The estimated total value of transactions the individual expects to process annually on the platform, in USD.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the participant

appropriateness_test_results.description: The results of a participant to determining whether or not they have enough knowledge and experience to understand the risks associated with trading an instrument (in ZH case, crypto).

result.description: The results of the administered appropriateness test

timestamp.description: The date when the test result was generated

kyc_attempts.description: The number of KYC attempts done by the participant.

citizenship_code.description: The ISO-3166-1 alpha2 citizenship of the participant, e.g. `US`.

email_screening.description: Whether the participant passed email screening

tin_jurisdiction_reason.description: Optional. Reason for the tax residence jurisdiction differing from the legal jurisdiction. Defaults to `unknown` if not provided.

tin_jurisdiction_other.description: Optional. Free text explanation when `tin_jurisdiction_reason` is `other`.

additional_tax_residences.description: Optional. Additional tax residences when the participant has tax obligations in multiple jurisdictions. Maximum 25 items.

proof_of_address_coordinates.description: GPS coordinates of the proof of address. Accepts both Decimal Degrees (DD) and Degrees/Minutes/Seconds (DMS) formats. Values are returned in DD format.

latitude.description: Latitude. Accepts both Decimal Degrees (DD) and Degrees/Minutes/Seconds (DMS) formats. Values are returned in DD format.

longitude.description: Longitude. Accepts both Decimal Degrees (DD) and Degrees/Minutes/Seconds (DMS) formats. Values are returned in DD format.

w8_ben.description: Wrapper sub-object holding W-8BEN tax certification data for a foreign (non-US) individual customer. Optional at the wrapper level.

ftin.description: Foreign tax identification number issued by the participant's country of tax residence. Required unless `ftin_required = false`.

ftin_required.description: Whether the participant's country legally issues an FTIN. Required whenever the sub-object is present.

reference_numbers.description: Optional free-text reference numbers for the platform to connect the tax form to a specific account or financial record.

is_eligible.description: Whether the participant is claiming reduced US withholding under a tax treaty. If `false` or omitted, the rest of the treaty block is ignored and no W-8 form is generated.

country.description: Participant's country of tax residence whose treaty with the US is being invoked (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

residence_certification.description: Participant's on-form attestation that they are a tax resident of `country`. Must be `true` to claim treaty benefits. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

income_type.description: Category of US-source income the claim applies to: `business_profits` covers trading gains and similar active income; `royalties_other` covers royalties and other passive income. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

withholding_rate.description: Reduced rate granted by the treaty article, as a string percentage (e.g. "0", "10", "15"). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

article_paragraph.description: Treaty article and paragraph authorizing the rate (e.g. "Article 12, paragraph 1"). Free text but should match the actual treaty section. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the participant asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the participant has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

w8_ben_e.description: Wrapper sub-object holding W-8BEN-E tax certification data for a foreign (non-US) entity customer. Inherits all shared W-8 fields plus the entity-only fields below. Optional at the wrapper level.

tax_classification.description: Entity's IRS tax classification (e.g. corporation, partnership, trust variants, estate, tax-exempt organization). Required for W-8 form generation when `w8_ben_e` is present. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

ftin.description: Foreign tax identification number issued by the entity's country of tax residence. Required unless `ftin_required = false`.

ftin_required.description: Whether the entity's country legally issues an FTIN. Required whenever the sub-object is present.

reference_numbers.description: Optional free-text reference numbers for the platform to connect the tax form to a specific account or financial record.

is_eligible.description: Whether the entity is claiming reduced US withholding under a tax treaty. If `false` or omitted, the rest of the treaty block is ignored and no W-8 form is generated.

country.description: Entity's country of tax residence whose treaty with the US is being invoked (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

residence_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it is a tax resident of `country`. Must be `true` to claim treaty benefits. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

income_type.description: Category of US-source income the claim applies to: `business_profits` covers trading gains and similar active income; `royalties_other` covers royalties and other passive income. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

withholding_rate.description: Reduced rate granted by the treaty article, as a string percentage (e.g. "0", "10", "15"). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

article_paragraph.description: Treaty article and paragraph authorizing the rate (e.g. "Article 7, paragraph 1"). Free text but should match the actual treaty section. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the entity asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the entity has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

requirements_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it derives the relevant income and meets all qualifying tests of the treaty provision. Must be `true` when an entity is claiming treaty benefits in order to generate a W-8 form. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

limitation_on_benefits.description: Which Limitation on Benefits (LOB) clause the entity qualifies under. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

limitation_on_benefits_other.description: Free-text describing the article and paragraph the entity is relying on. Required when (and only when) `limitation_on_benefits = other_article_paragraph`.

mailing_address.description: Mailing address when different from permanent address

country.description: ISO-3166-1-alpha-2

chamber_of_commerce_number.description: EU Chamber-of-Commerce registration number. Present only for EU NNP entities.

entity_source_of_funds.description: The entity's declared source of funds. Present only for EU NNP entities.

entity_source_of_funds_description.description: Free-text description, required when entity_source_of_funds is `other`.
entity_source_of_funds_description.example: Grant funding from the EU innovation program

activity_locations.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the entity conducts business. Present only for EU NNP entities.

is_complex_structure.description: Whether the entity has a complex ownership structure requiring a legal opinion document. Present only for EU NNP entities.

entity_sub_type.description: Sub-classification for trust entities. Present only when entity_type is a trust (EU NNP).

declaration_no_effective_control.description: Attestation that no natural person has effective control over the entity. Present only for EU NNP entities.

declaration_no_effective_control_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the no-effective-control attestation was made.

declaration_no_foreseeable_changes.description: Attestation that no foreseeable changes to ownership/control exist. Present only for EU NNP entities.

declaration_no_foreseeable_changes_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the no-foreseeable-changes attestation was made.

reason_for_business_relationship.description: Free-form explanation of why the entity seeks a business relationship. Present only for EU NNP entities.

expected_annual_volume.description: The entity's expected annual transaction volume tier. Present only for entities.

participant_code.description: Unique participant code

as_of.description: Timestamp showing the exact query time in seconds since Unix epoch

limits.description: The limits permitted for the participant

tags.description: Tags associated with KYC Tier of Participant

limits.description: Array of limit configurations to apply to the participant. Use empty array to clear all limits.

type.description: Transaction types to which this limit applies

period.description: Time period in hours for the limit. Use 0 for lifetime limits.

configured_limit.description: The limit amount as a decimal string

asset.description: The asset/currency for the limit

participant_code.description: Unique participant code

status.description: The current status of the participant

user_email.description: Identifier of the user who last acted on this participant. Typically an email address, but may be any opaque user identifier.

name.description: Full display name of the participant.

is_not_subject_backup_withholding.description:

This acts as a positive attestation that the participant confirms they are not subject to backup withholding.

withholding_rate.description: Reduced rate granted by the treaty article, as a string percentage (e.g. "0", "10", "15"). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

article_paragraph.description: Treaty article and paragraph authorizing the rate (e.g. "Article 12, paragraph 1"). Free text but should match the actual treaty section. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the participant asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the participant has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the participant asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the participant has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

oneOf.description: Patch for W-9 form certification, signature, and exemption fields.

is_w_form_certified.description:
Indicates whether the participant is W-Form certified, required for customers onboarded to a US platform.

 - When `true`, user can be onboarded without restriction, so long as other mandatory fields are provided at time of onboarding.
 - When `false`, user is restricted and ineligible to transact on the platform.

w_form_certification.description:
Must be provided with `is_w_form_certified` boolean field to indicate the time at which the user certified their W-form.

In the event the user transitions from an uncertified to a certified, the platform must provide a new `w_form_certification` and update `is_w_form_certified` from `false` to `true`.

signature.description: This field is used to capture the customer's first and last name as used on the W-form.

signature_timestamp.description: This field captures the timestamp at which the user signed their W-form, used in conjunction with the `signature` field.

payee_exemption.description: Payee exemption field that captures enum values for any applicable payee exemption codes 1 - 13, or NONE if no exemption applies. Required for customers onboarded to a US platform.

fatca_reporting_exemption.description: FATCA reporting exemption code (1-13 or NONE)

is_not_subject_backup_withholding.description:
Backup withholding attestation flag. Required for customers onboarded to a US platform.
 - If the participant confirms they are **not** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `true`.
 - If the participant **is** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `false`.
This acts as a positive attestation that the participant confirms they are not subject to backup withholding.

is_not_subject_backup_withholding.description:
Backup withholding attestation flag. Required for customers onboarded to a US platform.
 - If the participant confirms they are **not** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `true`.
 - If the participant **is** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `false`.
This acts as a positive attestation that the participant confirms they are not subject to backup withholding.

dba_name.description: Doing Business As (DBA) name of the entity

other_entity_type.description: Other entity type description when entity_type is "other"

w8_ben_e.description: Wrapper sub-object holding W-8BEN-E tax certification data for a foreign (non-US) entity customer. Inherits all shared W-8 fields plus the entity-only fields below. Optional at the wrapper level.

tax_classification.description: Entity's IRS tax classification (e.g. corporation, partnership, trust variants, estate, tax-exempt organization). Required for W-8 form generation when `w8_ben_e` is present. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

ftin.description: Foreign tax identification number issued by the entity's country of tax residence. Required unless `ftin_required = false`.

ftin_required.description: Whether the entity's country legally issues an FTIN. Required whenever the sub-object is present.

reference_numbers.description: Optional free-text reference numbers for the platform to connect the tax form to a specific account or financial record.

is_eligible.description: Whether the entity is claiming reduced US withholding under a tax treaty. If `false` or omitted, the rest of the treaty block is ignored and no W-8 form is generated.

country.description: Entity's country of tax residence whose treaty with the US is being invoked (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

residence_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it is a tax resident of `country`. Must be `true` to claim treaty benefits. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

income_type.description: Category of US-source income the claim applies to: `business_profits` covers trading gains and similar active income; `royalties_other` covers royalties and other passive income. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

withholding_rate.description: Reduced rate granted by the treaty article, as a string percentage (e.g. "0", "10", "15"). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

article_paragraph.description: Treaty article and paragraph authorizing the rate (e.g. "Article 7, paragraph 1"). Free text but should match the actual treaty section. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the entity asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the entity has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

requirements_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it derives the relevant income and meets all qualifying tests of the treaty provision. Must be `true` when an entity is claiming treaty benefits in order to generate a W-8 form. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

limitation_on_benefits.description: Which Limitation on Benefits (LOB) clause the entity qualifies under. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

limitation_on_benefits_other.description: Free-text describing the article and paragraph the entity is relying on. Required when (and only when) `limitation_on_benefits = other_article_paragraph`.

mailing_address.description: Root-level object on both customer and entity payloads (form-agnostic; also reused by W-9). Send only when the participant's mailing address differs from their permanent (W-8BEN) or incorporation (W-8BEN-E) address.

address_one.description: Primary street line of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

address_two.description: Secondary street line (unit, suite, etc.). Optional.

city.description: City of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

state.description: State, province, or region of the mailing address. Optional.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

country.description: Country of the mailing address (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when the object is present.

merchant_category_code.description: ISO 18245 four-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC) that identifies the business activity of the entity. Accepted on entity create/update; zerohash derives `merchant_category_code_category` and `merchant_category_code_classification` from this value.

chamber_of_commerce_number.description: Chamber of commerce registration number for EU entities.

activity_locations.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the entity conducts business activities.

entity_source_of_funds.description: Primary source of funds for the entity.

entity_source_of_funds_description.description: Description of entity source of funds, required when entity_source_of_funds is "other".

entity_sub_type.description: Sub-classification of entity type, applicable to trust entities.

is_complex_structure.description: Whether the entity has a complex ownership structure.

declaration_no_effective_control.description: Declaration that no individual has effective control beyond listed beneficial owners.

declaration_no_effective_control_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when declaration_no_effective_control was made.

declaration_no_foreseeable_changes.description: Declaration that no foreseeable changes to the beneficial ownership structure are expected.

declaration_no_foreseeable_changes_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when declaration_no_foreseeable_changes was made.

reason_for_business_relationship.description: Reason for establishing the business relationship with zerohash. Optional in both US and EU variants.
reason_for_business_relationship.example: Digital asset custody and trading services for institutional clients

board_members.description: Board members of the entity. Required for EU entities.

expected_annual_volume.description: Expected annual transaction volume for the entity. Required for EU entities.

fatca_reporting_exemption.description: FATCA reporting exemption code (1-13 or NONE)

is_not_subject_backup_withholding.description:
Backup withholding attestation flag. Required for customers onboarded to a US platform.
 - If the participant confirms they are **not** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `true`.
 - If the participant **is** subject to backup withholding, this field should be set to `false`.
This acts as a positive attestation that the participant confirms they are not subject to backup withholding.

dba_name.description: Doing Business As (DBA) name of the entity

other_entity_type.description: Other entity type description when entity_type is "other"

w8_ben_e.description: Wrapper sub-object holding W-8BEN-E tax certification data for a foreign (non-US) entity customer. Inherits all shared W-8 fields plus the entity-only fields below. Optional at the wrapper level.

tax_classification.description: Entity's IRS tax classification (e.g. corporation, partnership, trust variants, estate, tax-exempt organization). Required for W-8 form generation when `w8_ben_e` is present. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

ftin.description: Foreign tax identification number issued by the entity's country of tax residence. Required unless `ftin_required = false`.

ftin_required.description: Whether the entity's country legally issues an FTIN. Required whenever the sub-object is present.

reference_numbers.description: Optional free-text reference numbers for the platform to connect the tax form to a specific account or financial record.

is_eligible.description: Whether the entity is claiming reduced US withholding under a tax treaty. If `false` or omitted, the rest of the treaty block is ignored and no W-8 form is generated.

country.description: Entity's country of tax residence whose treaty with the US is being invoked (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

residence_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it is a tax resident of `country`. Must be `true` to claim treaty benefits. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

income_type.description: Category of US-source income the claim applies to: `business_profits` covers trading gains and similar active income; `royalties_other` covers royalties and other passive income. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

withholding_rate.description: Reduced rate granted by the treaty article, as a string percentage (e.g. "0", "10", "15"). Required when `is_eligible = true`.

article_paragraph.description: Treaty article and paragraph authorizing the rate (e.g. "Article 7, paragraph 1"). Free text but should match the actual treaty section. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

additional_conditions.description: Whether the entity asserts that extra conditions in the treaty article are met. Send `true` only if the entity has affirmatively confirmed. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

requirements_certification.description: Entity's on-form attestation that it derives the relevant income and meets all qualifying tests of the treaty provision. Must be `true` when an entity is claiming treaty benefits in order to generate a W-8 form. Required when `is_eligible = true`.

limitation_on_benefits.description: Which Limitation on Benefits (LOB) clause the entity qualifies under. Required when `is_eligible = true`. Accepted string tokens listed in enum; legacy numeric values still accepted for backward compatibility.

limitation_on_benefits_other.description: Free-text describing the article and paragraph the entity is relying on. Required when (and only when) `limitation_on_benefits = other_article_paragraph`.

mailing_address.description: Root-level object on both customer and entity payloads (form-agnostic; also reused by W-9). Send only when the participant's mailing address differs from their permanent (W-8BEN) or incorporation (W-8BEN-E) address.

address_one.description: Primary street line of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

address_two.description: Secondary street line (unit, suite, etc.). Optional.

city.description: City of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

state.description: State, province, or region of the mailing address. Optional.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the mailing address. Required when the object is present.

country.description: Country of the mailing address (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Required when the object is present.

merchant_category_code.description: ISO 18245 four-digit Merchant Category Code (MCC) that identifies the business activity of the entity. Accepted on entity create/update; zerohash derives `merchant_category_code_category` and `merchant_category_code_classification` from this value.

merchant_category_code_category.description: Human-readable category derived by zerohash from `merchant_category_code`. Returned in responses only; not accepted as input.

merchant_category_code_classification.description: Classification derived by zerohash from `merchant_category_code`, used to determine how the merchant is treated for downstream payment flows. Returned in responses only; not accepted as input.

trade_id.description: The unique identifier assigned to the trade, which is the same `trade_id` as found in a `GET /trades` request. Note: the `quote_id` will be saved as the `client_trade_id`.

trade_ids_list.description: All `trade_id`s booked as part of this reward. The first element matches `trade_id`; additional entries represent any settlement / bookkeeping legs created by the platform.

status.description: The status of the trade.

asset_cost_notional.description: Notional cost of the underlying delivered to the participant, expressed in the `quoted_currency` (i.e. `price * quantity`).

batch_trade_id.description: A unique identifier for a batch of trades. Null when the trade was not submitted as part of a batch.

client_trade_id.description: A unique identifier for the trade, generally produced by the Platform on which the trade was executed. Note: this must be unique, per platform, per 72 hour period

trade_reporter.description: A text field to indicate the name or identifier of the person or entity submitting the trade, e.g. an email address

trade_reporter_code.description: A code to identify the person or entity submitting the trade

reporting_party.description: The original reporter of the trade. This field is optional and must be a 6 digit participant code of which you have proper relationships with. Null when not supplied at trade submission.

settlement_schedule.description: Instructs zerohash to settle trades according to a certain schedule. Null when not supplied at trade submission.

platform_code.description: The unique identifier to the Platform on which the trade was executed, as provided by zerohash.

market_identifier_code.description: The [ISO 10383](https://www.iso20022.org/market-identifier-codes) market identifier code for the platform. Null when not supplied at trade submission.

symbol.description: A free text field to identify the pair being traded, e.g. `BTC/USD`

trade_type.description: The type of trade to be settled. Valid values are `regular` or `block`

trade_price.description:
The price the trade was executed
Note: if the `amount` is included per side, then this must equal to the seller's `amount` divided by the buyer's `amount` accurate for up to 20 figures.

trade_quantity.description:
The quantity purchased
Note: if the `amount` is included per side, then this should not be included, otherwise it is required

trade_state.description:
The current state of the trade;
 - `accepted` : The trade has been booked by zerohash and pending settlement in the next settlement cycle between the platform and zerohash.
 - `active` : The trades are eligible for settlement and there are pending payable and receivable obligations.
 - `terminated` : The trade has been terminated by settlement.

physical_delivery.description: A boolean statement to indicate if the trade is physically delivered. Currently zerohash only supports physically-settled trades, i.e. a value of `true`

transaction_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp the trade was executed on the external platform in milliseconds

accepted_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp at which the trade was accepted by zerohash and entered into an `accepted` status.

defaulted_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp in milliseconds at which the trade was defaulted. Null when the trade has not defaulted.

settled_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp in milliseconds at which the trade entered a `settled` state. Trades are generally settled instantaneously. Null until the trade is settled.

comment.description: Some comments about the trade for zerohash to store. Null when not supplied at trade submission.
comment.example: OTC trade executed via phone instruction

last_update.description: The unix timestamp of the last update to the trade object.

parties_anonymous.description: A boolean flag to determine if the counterparties are known to each other (`false` if the `platform_code` is also a counterparty) to the trade.

settlement_price_index_id.description: The unique identifier of the benchmark settlement price to be used when calculating settlement obligations on trades that are settled at zerohash - required for `forwards` only. Null for `spot` trades.

settlement_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp in milliseconds when final settlement will first be attempted - if not included, the standard platform settlement instructions will be applied. Null when not supplied at trade submission.

expiry_timestamp.description: The last unix timestamp in milliseconds that the product can be traded, and the datetime that all final prices will be set, i.e. the fixing date - relevant for `forwards` only. Note: after this point, there is no more ability to exit the trade or change its economics. Null for `spot` trades.

bank_fee.description: An optional field that clients can use to specify the fee taken by the banking partner (supports 2 decimal places). Null when not supplied at trade submission.

spread_notional.description: The `spread_notional` is a field that shows the notional cost of the spread applied to the trade. This field is relevant for trades that are executed using the zerohash RFQ system. Returns null when no spread applied.

spread_bps.description: The `spread_bps` is a field that shows the spread in basis points that was applied to the trade. This field is relevant for trades that are executed using the zerohash RFQ system. Returns null when no spread applied.

issuer_fee_rate.description: The rate (in basis points) of the issuer fee applied to the trade. Returns null when no issuer fee applied.

issuer_fee_amount.description: The notional amount of the issuer fee applied to the trade, denominated in the `quoted_currency`. Returns null when no issuer fee applied.

issuer_fee_payor_type.description: The type of payor that paid the issuer fee. Returns null when no issuer fee applied.

origin.description: Specifies the method through which the movement was initiated, indicating whether it originated via our REST API, SDK, or Secondary Portal. Returns null for legacy/externally-reported trades.

side.description: The `side` of the trade for the participant - `buy` or `sell`

participant_code.description: The `participant_code` of the trade party.

asset.description: The asset being traded by the party.

amount.description: The amount of the `asset` being traded by the party.

liquidity_indicator.description: Indicates whether the party added or removed liquidity from the market. This field is relevant for orders that were executed on the zerohash CLOB.

client_order_id.description: A unique ID for the trade, preferably a UUID.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order generated on the zerohash CLOB.

obligations_outstanding_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp in milliseconds when the party entered an `obligations_outstanding` settlement state. Null when the party has not yet entered this state.

current_obligations_met_timestamp.description: The unix timestamp in milliseconds when the party met its current obligations. Null when obligations have not yet been met.

settlement_state.description: The current settlement state for this party. Null when the trade is in `accepted` state and settlement has not yet been attempted.

execution_id.description: The unique identifier for the execution of the trade. Null when the trade was not executed on the zerohash CLOB.

settling.description: Indicates whether this party is responsible for settling its side of the trade at zerohash.

account_label.description: The `account_label` that the party executed the trade on, if applicable. This field is relevant for platforms integrated using custom `account_label` for the zerohash participants. If not provided, the trade will be associated with the default (`general`) account for the participant.

collateral_percentage.description: The percentage of collateral required for the trade. Null when collateralization does not apply.

account_profile.description: The account profile associated with the executing account (e.g. `nonprefunded`). Null when the party is not tied to a profiled account.

trader.description: Participant who placed the order on the trading zerohash trading venue. This field is relevant for orders that were executed on the zerohash CLOB using the Multi Tenant Accounts. Null when not applicable.

zrn.description: The `urn` associated with the account that executed the trade, if applicable. This field is relevant for platforms integrated with the zerohash Multi Tenant Accounts. Returns null when the trade was not executed by a multi-tenant account.

manual_order_indicator.description: Indicates if the order was submitted manually via a user interface or via an API / Automated solution. Null when not applicable.

session_id.description: A session identifier to group filled orders that were executed in the same trading session on the zerohash CLOB. An empty string is returned when the trade was not executed on the zerohash CLOB.

payment_processor.description: Identifier for the payment service processor that funded the trade, when applicable. Null when the trade was not funded via a payment processor.

name.description: The name of the payment processor

id.description: The unique identifier of the payment according to the PSP
